question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pinnacle**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the significant events of the French Revolution and its critical period.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the most important or peak moment of the revolution.
 
• "**Pinnacle**" fits well as it denotes the highest or most important point of an event, which aligns with the critical period of the revolution in 1789.
 
• Other options ("**fall**", "**foundation**", "**middle**") do not fit the context of describing the peak or most crucial moment of the French Revolution.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The French Revolution is a revolutionary movement that occurred in France between 1787 and 1799 and reached to its** pinnacle__**in 1789. This revolution had many causes but the most important of all was**__ the rise__**of bourgeoisie, who were merchants, manufacturers and professionals. The peasants, many of them landowners, wanted to get rid of the practices of absolute monarchy and feudalism. Another factor was an increase in population due to decreased mortality rates. It was followed by economic predicament and minor revolts were common. This led to a clarion call for social reforms. Intellectuals like Rene Descartes wrote about new things about political, social and economic matters. A fundamental political and societal change was to occur. The French Revolution played a critical role in shaping modern nations by showing the world the power inherent in the will of the people.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Fall (गिरावट): "Fall" means a downward movement or decline, which does not convey the peak or peak moment of the revolution.
 
• Foundation (आधार): "Foundation" means the basis or groundwork of something, which does not fit the context of the peak moment of the revolution.
 
• Middle (मध्य): "Middle" means the point or position at an equal distance from the sides, which does not align with describing the peak or peak moment of the French Revolution.
